notes: GSK paid $1B upfront + $400M in regulatory CVR milestones for Aiolos Bio's AIO-001 — a long-acting anti-TSLP monoclonal antibody for severe asthma, in-licensed from Jiangsu Hengrui in 2023. Phase 1 / Phase 2-ready at deal time. Positioned as a longer-dosing-interval competitor to Tezspire (tezepelumab, Amgen/AstraZeneca, also anti-TSLP). Total $1.4B reflects upfront + CVR; standalone upfront $1.0B is the comp value if you exclude milestones. Use $1.4B for the cohort to include the full deal value including milestone-contingent consideration.
selection_rationale: Smaller-deal anchor for the autoimmune-mAb cohort to balance the larger Prometheus and Horizon comparables. Represents a Phase 1 / early-Phase-2 in-licensing-style acquisition rather than late-stage M&A — useful for triangulating the multiple paid for earlier-stage biologics. Also tests the framework's coverage of asthma/respiratory immunology, which often gets grouped with autoimmune in modeling.
source: GSK press release Jan 8 2024; Aiolos Bio announcement; Endpoints News coverage.
